QF.id: AIFM Fee Structure and Fund Performance_51

question.text: Ananya Alpha Fund (Cat III) has Gross NAV of INR 80 crore at year-end. Management fee is 1.75% (excl. GST 18%). What is the management fee CHARGED TO THE FUND (inclusive of GST)?

explanation.text: The Logic: Management fee = 1.75% × INR 80 crore = INR 1.40 crore. Applying 18% GST: INR 1.40 crore × 1.18 = INR 1.6520 crore charged to the fund. The workbook examples support applying GST to AIF management fees. The Trap: Option A ignores GST and reports only the base fee. Option C uses the gross fee rate (1.75%) as a rupee amount. Option B is off by an order of magnitude (decimal-placement error). Note: The "charged to the fund" figure is always GST-inclusive when GST applies to management fees.
